subject: Vulnerability scan rhythm and CVE closure affirmation for FinPlatform SOC2
messages:
From: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@finplatform.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: soc2@finplatform.com
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 request: scan cadence, SLAs, and CVE closure confirmation

Ben —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of our SOC2 scoping we need a written confirmation of Redwood Inference's vulnerability management rhythm and your operational SLAs for CVE remediation. Specifically, FinPlatform needs: 

- A short description of authenticated scanning cadence (internal + third-party) and how results are triaged.
- CVE remediation target windows by severity (Critical / High / Medium / Low).
- Who owns remediation (engineering teams / SRE / product) and how you track closures for auditors.
- An exportable index or matrix showing recent scan runs and outstanding items (CSV or PDF is fine).

We'd like to close this in the next 10 business days for our auditor. Can you provide an affirmation email and the supporting artifacts?

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 30-min sync if that helps.

Claire Dunn
Security Assurance Manager
FinPlatform

---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@finplatform.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 request: scan cadence, SLAs, and CVE closure confirmation

Claire —

Thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide this. Looping in Monica (Security Ops lead) and Laura (Customer Security & Compliance) to assemble the artifacts and the concise affirmation you can pass to your auditor.

High-level answer up front:
- Authenticated scans: weekly internal authenticated scans + nightly lightweight unauthenticated checks; monthly external scanning by third-party (creds scanning quarterly for critical paths).
- CVE closure targets: Critical: 7 days; High: 30 days; Medium: 90 days; Low: risk-accepted or scheduled in planned maintenance.
- Ownership: initial triage by Security Ops (Monica) -> assigned to responsible service owner in Engineering -> tracked in Jira with SLA flags and remediation columns.

We'll attach an export of the scan index and a remedial closure matrix. Monica — can you confirm the exact JIRA filter and attach the matrix? Laura — will add the SOC2 mapping note for the auditor.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SOC2 request: scan cadence, SLAs, and CVE closure confirmation

Monica / Laura — forwarding Claire's ask. Below are the pragmatic items we should include for FinPlatform auditor: 

1) One-page affirmation statement (signed by Security Ops owner) that outlines scan cadence and CVE SLAs.
2) CSV export of scan index (last 90 days) with columns: scan_id, date, target_scope, authenticated?, findings_count, critical_count, high_count, outstanding_jira_link.
3) CVE closure matrix (PDF) with explicit remediation dates for open critical/high items and closure evidence (PR links, patch notes).
4) Link to the Jira saved filter and the runbook describing triage -> assignment -> verification steps.

Operational constraints / suggested wording for SLAs: Critical (7 calendar days) — auto-escalate to on-call lead if no assignee; High (30 calendar days) — tracked on A/B list for sprint planning; Medium (90 days) — tracked via backlog; Low — documented exception process.

Monica: can you export the authenticated-scan-config.json and run the CSV export of the last 12 weekly authenticated runs? Ideally include the earliest run date and indicate when external scans were performed. Laura: please draft the one-pager affirmation we can sign and include the auditors' contact that Claire provided.

Thanks —
Ben

---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@finplatform.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, soc2@finplatform.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 request: scan cadence, SLAs, and CVE closure confirmation

Claire —

Apologies for the short delay; attaching the requested artifacts and the signed affirmation from our Security Ops lead. Summary / highlights below for your auditor to include in the SOC2 evidence packet: 

- Scan rhythm: weekly authenticated scans (internal credentials) across all production VPCs; nightly lightweight unauthenticated health checks; third-party full external scans monthly and quarterly credentialed scans for customer-facing components.
- Triage & assignment: Security Ops (Monica) performs initial triage within 24 hours of scan ingestion and creates Jira tickets for actionable findings. Tickets are labelled with severity and SLA tier; owners are assigned by service area.
- Remediation SLAs: Critical: 7 calendar days (auto-escalation to SRE on-call if unassigned after 48 hours). High: 30 calendar days. Medium: 90 calendar days. Low: exception process for business-accepted risk. These SLA targets are recorded in our runbook and reflected in the Jira workflow.
- Tracking & evidence: the attached "cve_closure_matrix_FP-2319.pdf" shows remediation status for critical/high items for the last 90 days (PR links and deployment dates included). The CSV export "vm_scan_index_202708.csv" lists weekly run metadata.

Attachments included:
- vm_scan_index_202708.csv (CSV export — last 12 authenticated scan runs; columns: scan_id,date,scope,authenticated,findings,critical,high,outstanding_jira)
- cve_closure_matrix_FP-2319.pdf (PDF — remediation matrix with PR/deploy evidence)
- authenticated-scan-config.json (scanner config snippet showing auth method and cron)
- Affirmation: signed statement by Monica Patel (Security Ops Lead) confirming cadence and SLA commitments.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and if the auditor needs any additional artifacts (e.g., ticket history exports or a short recording/walkthrough). If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min session with Monica and Laura.

Best regards,

Ben Carter
